question: $15.$ 设向量组 $\alpha_1 = \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 0 \\ -1 \end{pmatrix}$，$\alpha_2 = \begin{pmatrix} a \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$，$\alpha_3 = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 1 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$ 不可由向量组 $\beta_1 = \begin{pmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \\ 2 \end{pmatrix}$，$\beta_2 = \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 3 \\ 7 \end{pmatrix}$，$\beta_3 = \begin{pmatrix} a \\ 0 \\ -a \end{pmatrix}$ 线性表示，则 $a$ 的取值范围为 ______
